step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates an automated healing and monitoring framework for SAP systems on AWS developed by Linke. Infrastructure metrics and events from the EC2 application layer are sent to CloudWatch and CloudWatch Events. CloudWatch Events notifies an SNS topic, which fans out to send alerts to external Email/ITSM systems and invokes a healing Lambda function (which can also be triggered directly via CloudWatch for application checks). The healing Lambda executes remediation scripts via AWS Systems Manager (SSM) Run Command to restore the SAP application and database environment.

edges.notes: EC2 application sends infrastructure metrics to CloudWatch.
CloudWatch triggers Lambda for application health checks.
Infrastructure failure events trigger CloudWatch Events.
CloudWatch Events forwards events to SNS topic.
SNS topic notifies team via Email or ITSM integration.
SNS topic invokes the healing Lambda function.
Healing Lambda executes commands using SSM Run Command.
SSM executes OS/SAP remediation commands to restore the SAP database and system.
